key.mouse.left.context: World attack versus JEI hover, recipe, bookmark, cheat and edit actions in their native GUI contexts.

key.mouse.right.context: Vanilla use and mounted aircraft use share the same gesture. ParCool checks for a climbable wall. JEI uses GUI and hover contexts.

key.keyboard.w.context: Move forward on foot; forward or pitch down depending on the aircraft controls.

key.keyboard.a.context: Move left on foot or in the aircraft, JEI bookmark while hovering in a screen.

key.keyboard.s.context: Move backward on foot; backward or pitch up depending on the aircraft controls.

key.keyboard.d.context: Move right on foot or while piloting.

key.keyboard.space.context: Jump on foot, jump against a wall in ParCool, ascend or increase throttle while piloting.

key.keyboard.left.shift.context: Sneak or prepare a ParCool breakfall on foot, descend or reduce throttle while piloting, pause recipe cycling in JEI.

key.keyboard.left.control.context: Vanilla sprint and ParCool fast run intentionally share the author movement gesture.

key.mouse.middle.context: Pick block in the world, JEI cheat stack or backpack sort in screens.
